content.title: THE SINGERS | Dir. Sam Davis on Embracing Chaos for His Oscar-Winning Short Film
content.text: How do you make an Oscar-winning film without a script, without a shot list, and with first-time actors found on social media? Director Sam Davis joins Directors Notes for a behind the scenes interview to break down his live-action short film, The Singers. In this deep dive, Sam reveals the "Chaos Soup" method of filmmaking—a terrifying yet magical approach where the crew had to improvise just as much as the cast. Discover how a 19th-century Russian short story by Ivan Turgenev was transformed into a modern-day tale of masculinity and vulnerability, set in a dingy dive bar. Sam discusses the technical tightrope walk of shooting on 35mm film while capturing live, raw audio (including a stunning performance in a bathroom for natural reverb). Plus, hear the incredible story of finding his cast on TikTok, the improvised line about "cocaine withdrawal," and the terrifying moment a lead actor got cold feet just two days before the shoot. 👀 Watch The Singers now on Netflix https://www.netflix.com/title/82699221 🔔 Watch more interviews with visionary filmmakers on our channel: / directorsnotes 🎥 Want to see your film here?
